notes: 13 frames extracted this session at native 1920x1080 and every one visually verified in-session (see verified_visual). recording.json lists a 2880x1620 CDP capture surface, but the encoded MP4 is native 1920x1080, so no upscaling was performed. Coverage is the lesson's spine: the class/grade taxonomy diagram, the Class-3 destination demo, Class-1 grades 2-7, Class-2 grades 1-2, the Class-3 orchestrator inventory + final log-stream UI, and the closing 'Prioritize Agentics' tactic card. Two beats were intentionally left unframed: (a) Class-1 Grade-1's standalone beat is talking-head B-roll with only a label, and Grade 1 (the thinnest layer) is already legible as the smallest ring inside the taxonomy frame t0382; (b) the codebase-singularity definition (~4:24) is overhead-keyboard B-roll and should be rendered as a designed pull-quote, not a frame (see diagram_instead entry). The dense orchestrator inventory frame was saved as PNG because it contains small text (slash-command badges + tool signatures).
